about: Golden cases for the metric-checkpoint/v1 validator (plan 2026-10-06-overview-objectives-view, Appendix A). Phase 1 (qontinui-web, app/overview/metric_checkpoint.py) runs every case; Phase 3 (qontinui-coord) copies them and skips web_only cases, which need the metric document's declared checkpoints and criteria. An undeclared checkpoint is a web-only refusal; an undeclared row id is a web-only WARNING (plan D5). error_field is one of the dotted paths the validator must name; warning_fields must be warned, not refused.
